title.description: Article title, contains the target query naturally. List posts put the number of items first, e.g. '9 best free PDF editors that need no install'.

description.description: Meta description: one sentence on what the reader gets, no title repetition.

intro.description: Markdown, 2 short paragraphs, no headings. First sentence answers what the list is for and who it suits.

name.description: The site or tool's own name.

url.description: Official https URL of the site or the tool's own page. No redirects, affiliates or shorteners.

oneLiner.description: What it does, in one plain sentence.

body.description: Markdown, 40-110 words: what it is good at, one standout detail, who should use it. No headings.

bestFor.description: Short phrase: the job or person it suits best.

catch.description: The honest limitation in plain words (watermark, sign-up, daily cap, file size...). No prices.

outro.description: Markdown that follows the list, starting at an H2 (##). Follows the format spec. No closing call-to-action.

heroLine.description: A short handwritten-style note for the cover image, lowercase, e.g. 'no watermark, no sign-up'.
